description: Individual representative's full floor speech or congressional statement — produced as a drill-down child snap from a multi-entity parent (e.g., floor-debate). Appears as a standalone snap in the Accountability feed AND is navigable via tap from the parent snap's speaker entry.

productionSpec.speakerNotes: Source the full speech text from the Congressional Record (congress.gov/congressional-record) — full text is public domain. speechContext should identify the bill and date, e.g. 'Floor statement on H.R.2616 — PROTECT Kids Act, May 20, 2026'. speechText should be a significant excerpt (150–600 words) or the full speech if brief. snapTitle should be 'Floor Speech' for chamber floor statements or 'Congressional Statement' for other formal statements.

snapTitle.rule: Use 'Floor Speech' for house/senate floor statements. Use 'Congressional Statement' for press statements, official positions. Use 'Committee Testimony' for committee hearing testimony.

repId.source: Congress.gov Bioguide ID — validated by normalizer

repName.source: Congress.gov member data — full preferred name

repLocation.source: Congress.gov member data — state or district label

speechText.rule: Full speech text or significant excerpt (150–600 words). Must be verbatim from the Congressional Record — no paraphrasing. Public domain.
speechText.example: "Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R.2616..."

speechDate.source: Congressional Record — date of the floor statement

speechContext.rule: Use format: 'Floor statement on [Bill ID] — [Bill Short Title], [Month Day, Year]'
speechContext.example: Floor statement on H.R.2616 — PROTECT Kids Act, May 20, 2026

billId.source: Congress.gov — canonical bill ID, validated by normalizer

billIdSlug.source: Generator — URL-safe version of billId (lowercase, hyphens)

floorVoteComplete.rule: true if bill has passed or failed a floor vote; false if still in committee or pre-vote

sentimentQuestion.rule: Must be a direct civic question about the policy impact of this rep's statement. NOT about the rep personally. 2–4 options. Example: 'Does this speech change your view on online child safety legislation?'
sentimentQuestion.example: Do you support stricter regulations on social media platforms to protect minors?

sentimentOptions.rule: 2–4 options. At least one must represent a clearly opposing position. Options must be civic/policy-focused, not partisan.

parentSpawnRef.source: Miner — the SPAWN ID of the parent floor-debate snap that spawned this child
parentSpawnRef.rule: Set from the child SPAWN file's parentSnapRef field. Used by the distributor for backfill resolution.

parentSnapRole.source: Generator — human-readable description of the parent snap

drillDownRole.source: Miner — from drillDownRole field on child SPAWN

repLastName.source: Derived from repName — last name only, lowercase

sourceLabel.source: Generator — human-readable name of the primary source
sourceLabel.rule: Use 'Congressional Record' for floor speech text. May also cite Congress.gov for bill context.

sourceUrl.source: Congressional Record URL — goes into Trust.Thread sources[].url ONLY
sourceUrl.rule: Use the Congressional Record URL directly. Do NOT populate any other element with this URL.

auditDate.source: Today's date — date this snap was generated

spawnRef.source: Miner — SPAWN ID for this child snap

verificationLevel.rule: Use 'Tier 3' for Congressional Record primary source. Use 'VERIFIED' when Congressional Record + Congress.gov are both cited as sources.
